description.en: Personal portfolio & music showcase built with Astro 7, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Features a zero-JS by default architecture, Cloudflare Pages hosting, and a high-performance Cyber-Noir glassmorphic design.
description.it: Portfolio personale e showcase musicale realizzato con Astro 7, TypeScript e Tailwind CSS v4. Architettura zero-JS di default, hosting su Cloudflare Pages ed estetica Cyber-Noir in glassmorphism ad alte prestazioni.
